metadata.name: article_registry
metadata.description: Article Registry — on-chain article storage built with Anchor

instructions.name: create_article_entry
docs: Creates a new article entry as a PDA seeded by [title, owner].
The owner pays for rent and is permanently stored on the account.
Title and published_date are immutable after creation.

accounts.name: article_entry
docs: The article PDA account, initialized fresh.
Seeded by [title, owner] to ensure each owner has a unique entry per title.
Space is calculated using `ArticleEntry::INIT_SPACE` plus the 8-byte discriminator.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The signer who creates and owns this article. Pays for account rent.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: Required by Anchor to initialize the PDA account.

instructions.name: delete_article_entry
docs: Closes the article entry account and returns all lamports to the owner.
The `_title` parameter is only needed to derive and verify the correct
PDA; the `close = owner` constraint handles the actual lamport transfer.

accounts.name: article_entry
docs: The article PDA to close. The `close = owner` constraint transfers all
remaining lamports back to the owner and zeroes the account data.
`has_one = owner` ensures only the original creator can delete this entry.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Receives the reclaimed lamports from the closed account.

instructions.name: update_article_entry
docs: Updates the mutable fields of an existing article entry.
The `_title` parameter is intentionally unused in the function body —
it is only required by the `UpdateEntry` accounts struct to derive the
correct PDA via the `#[instruction(title)]` attribute. Title and
published_date are immutable because title forms part of the PDA seed.

accounts.name: article_entry
docs: The existing article PDA, derived from the same [title, owner] seeds.
`has_one = owner` ensures the signer matches the stored owner field,
preventing any other wallet from modifying this entry.
No `realloc` needed because `max_len` allocates the maximum size upfront.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Must match `article_entry.owner`; enforced by the `has_one` constraint above.

errors.name: TitleTooLong
errors.msg: Title exceeds the maximum length of 50 characters

errors.name: DescriptionTooLong
errors.msg: Description exceeds the maximum length of 2000 characters

errors.name: ContentTooLong
errors.msg: Content exceeds the maximum length of 5000 characters

errors.name: TooManyReferences
errors.msg: References list exceeds the maximum of 5 entries

errors.name: ReferenceTooLong
errors.msg: A reference entry exceeds the maximum length of 200 characters

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: You are not authorized to modify or delete this article

types.name: ArticleEntry
docs: On-chain state stored for each article entry.

fields.name: owner
docs: The public key of the wallet that created and owns this article.

fields.name: title
docs: The article title. Max 50 characters.
Immutable after creation — it forms part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: description
docs: Short abstract / summary of the article. Max 2000 characters.

fields.name: content
docs: Full article content / body. Max 5000 characters.

fields.name: references
docs: Optional reference URLs or citations. Up to 5 entries, each max 200 characters.

fields.name: published_date
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) set at creation time. Immutable after creation.
